name: Stack Golem
notes: DRAFT for C13-2 (bestiary-plan.md). A tower of stones. Each hit knocks one off and it gets smaller. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#185/#186). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
senseiLine: Big things are made of small pieces.
description: A tower of stones. Each hit knocks one off and it gets smaller.

bestiary.tip: Keep going. It gets smaller and quicker.

lore.green: A pile of steps stacked itself up in the shadow. Calm it, and the stones rest as stairs again.
